text: Handling deadlines well requires a few simple skills. First, good time management helps you plan your work and avoid last-minute stress. Second, prioritization is important because you need to decide which tasks are most urgent and do them first. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish; sometimes you must reduce the work to meet the deadline. Finally, communication is key. If you think you may be late, tell your team or manager early so they can help or adjust plans. By combining these skills, you can meet deadlines more calmly and produce better results.
